import hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tarfile, tempfile
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
revisions=('4b2e30231c20d3374a39976df5a0f998a6c6f90c','d43e63c8872c4029c7edb9067d8f272642e7885a')
observations=[]
for rev in revisions:
    archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','--format=tar',rev],cwd=repo)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='frozen-skill-') as tmp:
        snapshot=pathlib.Path(tmp)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tf:
            tf.extractall(snapshot,filter='data')
        ns={'__name__':'measured_resolver','__file__':str(snapshot/'corpus/instruments/resolve.py')}
        source=(snapshot/'corpus/instruments/resolve.py').read_bytes()
        exec(compile(source,ns['__file__'],'exec'),ns)
        skill=(snapshot/'SKILL.md').read_bytes()
        cites={m.group(1).strip().rstrip('.,;:') for line in skill.decode().splitlines() for m in ns['TOKEN'].finditer(line) if ns['is_pathlike'](m.group(1).strip().rstrip('.,;:'))}
        frozen={t:ns['classify'](t,str(snapshot),os.path.expanduser(ns['MIRROR_ROOT']))[0] for t in cites}
        live={t:ns['classify'](t,str(repo),os.path.expanduser(ns['MIRROR_ROOT']))[0] for t in cites}
        row={'revision':rev,'frozen_resolves':sum(c!='GONE' for c in frozen.values()),'live_resolves':sum(c!='GONE' for c in live.values()),'distinct':len(cites),'skill_sha256':hashlib.sha256(skill).hexdigest(),'province_sha256':hashlib.sha256((snapshot/'PROVINCE.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'frozen_live_class_differences':{t:[frozen[t],live[t]] for t in sorted(cites) if frozen[t]!=live[t]}}
        print(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
        observations.append((row,frozen))
assert all((o[0]['frozen_resolves'],o[0]['distinct'])==(32,506) for o in observations)
assert observations[0][1]==observations[1][1]
print('SNAPSHOT_SKILL_GUARD: PASS frozen=32/506->32/506 changed_verdicts=0')
